evaluation.scope: Initial head-held scenes; reused exploratorily in followups. Visual teacher exposed, not pipeline-independent.

supported: Candidate geometry improves matched score-only discrimination across exposure/weighting controls.

scaling_original_recipe.conclusion: No stable scaling gain established after original recipe restored.

selection: No newly trained model promoted as a confirmed improvement over existing GEOQ; E0 and ambiguity gate also not confirmed.
stopping_rationale: Audit, actual feasibility, matched scaling, visual adaptation, interaction, geometry, subgroups and module evaluation complete. Positive pilot signal followed through full-query falsification, full-training expansion, OOF exposure restoration and original scene-weight/threshold reconstruction. Remaining independent generalization requires teacher-disjoint training or additional approved dense scenes; extra low-dimensional variants lack supporting evidence. Latest request allows negative outcomes.

_archive_export.selection: All source JSON fields retained; machine paths parameterized.
